segments.en: No, no, my name is Gautam.
I don't know, that's what it shows in the app ID.
Okay, okay, I am from Trichy.
Okay, okay, I am married too.
I couldn't tell from your voice, so I asked.
Okay, okay, do they go to school?
The elder one is in LKG, the younger one is two years old.
I shifted here five months ago.
Okay, where in Salem are you?
I am two years older than you.
Leave it, it's fine, let it be. What does it matter?
Should I not talk? Or is 31 not okay?
If you are okay with it, tell me.
Your voice is nice. Thank you.
No, you were asking something, tell me. I asked something in between, right?
I didn't ask anything. Where is your wife?
Oh, has she gone to her hometown?
That's why you came here to be curious, right?
More than me, you are the one who is curious.
Why are you saying that? Oh, I have come permanently, right?
How many kids do you have?
Only one daughter, three years old.
It's been three or four years since you got married, right?
At this time, your voice is very clear, I can hear it clearly. What are you doing? Are you not sleeping?
No, no, I am just holding the phone near my mouth and talking.
Are you staying with your in-laws, or have you come separately?
Separately. I don't have in-laws, both of them have passed away.
How are you staying alone without anyone's help?
I didn't rent a house, I bought a house.
Oh, okay, you bought a house.
I have my own house here, my mother's house is nearby, I have my own house.
I have some construction work, I have to finish some pending work.
So until then, I am staying in a rented house, they are all supporting me.
That's what I asked, how are you staying without anyone's support?
It's not like that, they are all there nearby, everyone, mother, grandfather, grandmother, mother, father, my family, aunt's family, brother's family.
Okay, I asked that, you are staying alone in Attur, right?
Yes, this is the place where I was born and brought up. Actually, it's been ten years since I got married in Chennai.
After ten years, I have come now.
No, for now, there is no work, the kids are small.
How long have you been using this app?
I installed it a long time ago, but I am not a regular user. I come occasionally.
Same here, I only use it when my wife goes out, otherwise I don't come.
Are you so scared of your wife?
It's not fear, it's just avoiding unnecessary problems.
She is okay, not too strict, not too liberal, okay, to an extent.
Do you like your wife very much?
Not very much, 70 percent. 30 percent, I don't like her, we fight sometimes.
What did she study? What did you study?
I am a B.E. Mechanical, she is an M.Sc. B.Ed.
So, since the kids are there, they don't go to work, they just stay at home.
Yes, it's going on like that. How about you? How do you like your husband?
My husband and I are not compatible.
From the beginning, it was like that.
His character doesn't suit me, not just me, it doesn't suit anyone else.
I am not saying this to complain, he is a very, very, very good person, a very good human being.
He has a very helpful tendency, he is the best father in this world, the best son, a good disciple to his guru.
But is he a good husband? If you ask, that doesn't suit him.
The way he grew up, there is a lot of age difference between him and me.
The way he grew up, in that generation, women, how his mother lived, that is, whoever said anything, she wouldn't answer back.
She would hide behind the door and answer back, like that.
He expects the same thing from me, how is that possible?
It's a generation gap, so how can you be in that generation?
If I say, 'Hey, give me tea, give me coffee,' then if I say my name and ask for tea, even if I ask ten times, he will not give it.
He will not give it, he will say, 'Give me tea, give me coffee.'
If I say, 'Hey, give me tea,' those who want to do it will not do it.
That is his nature, that's how he talks, his way of talking, his tone, nothing suits us.
Because I have also studied, I have also studied, I am also a good, what to say, I have lived in better conditions than him, I am a well-educated girl, at a young age.
Then why did you marry at this age? It should be like that, right?
That is another issue, leave it.
That is a big issue, then?
Actually, you are talking with a smile even about such a sad thing, it changes quickly.
That's because I'm used to it.
Because he, you know, I have completely come out of him.
I don't have anything in my mind, because he has hurt me to that extent.
That is, now, how do you know?
I will tell you one, one, one thing, you will understand it completely.
That is, now, in my house in Chennai, people come to clean the house, wash the dishes, they will come and go.
Until then, he will talk to me nicely, he will be talking in the morning.
When I enter inside before 10 o'clock, he will call me names, he will call me names, he will call me names.
I will ask, 'Why are you talking like this? Why are you insulting me in front of someone?'
Then, if you want to insult your wife in front of a third person, it means you don't have love for her.
If you really had love, you wouldn't do such a thing.
Even if you do it, we should talk within ourselves, right?
Yes, yes, I am not wrong, I am not wrong, I have not done anything wrong, I will not do it, really.
Let what I did be there.
No, did it happen like that, I am asking, in case he talks like that.
No, I am asking if anything wrong happened.
No, I am asking if you did something or he did something.
Yes, he does this many times.
This is how he treats me, this is how it is.
I have never taken money from his pocket.
He will say as if I took it.
Why should I take money from his pocket? He will shout in front of others, as if it's visible to everyone.
Why don't you have the sense that if I take money from his pocket, it will be known?
How many times should I tell him not to take money from my pocket?
If you put your hand, you won't know, don't you know that?
Okay, okay, okay, he is talking like that, super.
Cool, cool, cool, cool, cool, cool.
How can we live with a person like that?
He will not divorce, he will not give divorce.
No, I am asking openly, there is nothing wrong with this, I am asking you to share it.
Like that, we can be friends, but beyond that, I don't want any other relationship.
I don't want it, I can tell you directly, there is nothing wrong with it. You tell me, if you want to be friends, tell me.
Yes, friendship, to tell you the truth, I am a little busy, because I have to pick up and drop the kids, do this and that, and then in the evening I have to take tuition.
No, no, I will tell you, whenever you are free, whenever you feel like talking, you can call me. If you say friendship, it's okay.
Yes, the thing is, I don't have time, after that, I will share my ID with you, but I don't have the heart to let you suffer, that's what I am saying.
No, that's not needed, just give me your number, I will send a 'Hi' on WhatsApp.
No, I don't want to give my number, I will give my Telegram ID.
No, actually, I am telling you, people use WhatsApp, that's why I am saying, otherwise I can give it, no problem.
Everything, people use WhatsApp and Telegram. I will save it in my company's official number, that's all, nothing else.
My problem is the same, I am a little scared, that's the issue.
No, it's nothing, just give me your number, I will just say 'Hi', when you are free, you call me, that's all.
Otherwise, it's not good, because you will give it to your account, right?
No, we can talk, we can talk, we can talk a little.
Wait for some time, I need some time.
No, take your time, please cut it, after you said all this, I felt a bit strange, that's why I asked you to cut it.
You are so hurt, that's why I asked for the number immediately.
I am not hurt, I have come out of it, now I am not hurt at all.
How to say, it happened like that, it was just, now I am hurt, if you ask if I am hurt, I am not hurt.
Because, now, if I expect something from him, then it will hurt me.
But I am not expecting anything.
What did you eat at night?
When did you sleep? When did you wake up in the morning?
I woke up today, tomorrow, I won't wake up tomorrow, I will tell you, every day is a different story.
Okay, don't cut it, share the number and go, please.
But I can't talk, are you okay with that?
No, I will message you, you can call me when you are free, I have no problem.
The message has come, is the DP not there?
Yes, yes, I got the number, the DP didn't come.
Wait, I didn't save it, I will save it and message you.
I haven't shared my number with anyone yet.
I will tell you how to call me, what to do, everything in detail on WhatsApp.
I am scared, I have never done this to anyone, this is the first time.
I will not torture you, okay?
Wait, one minute, I will call you on that, WhatsApp call, voice call.
Don't do it, don't do it, don't do it.
